summary: Iteration 4 fully verified. Backend pytest: 75/75 passing in 25s (previous 55 regression tests + 20 new tests covering router refactor sanity, 24 courses / 10 full courses, 5 new industry courses × 15 modules × 12 quiz, complete Enterprise Portal flow (create org, one-org-per-user, mine, invite create/list/role-normalization/bad-email/seats-check, join via valid+invalid code + already-joined-400, dashboard summary with readiness_index=0 for fresh org + members[]+departments[]+top_courses[], seat adjust owner-only + clamp 10-5000 + cannot-reduce-below-usage + member-403, remove member with seat decrement + cannot-remove-owner-400), and Push-to-Curriculum (auth-required, missing-slug-400, unknown-signal-404, unknown-course-404, successful patch generation + course freshness bumped to 100 + last_reviewed_at=now, list patches + filter by course_slug/status, decide approved + invalid-decision-400 + unknown-patch-404). Frontend E2E: (1) new user with no org lands on /enterprise/portal hero with 'No organization yet' + 'Create organization' CTA + 'Join with invite code' link; (2) /enterprise/setup form (name, industry select, domain, seat_count 10-5000) submits and redirects to portal; (3) portal shows org name (data-testid=org-name), invite code with copy button, 4 stat cards (readiness_index, certs, avg progress, cert coverage), members table with self as owner, invite form (email/role/dept) that adds to invites list, seat management wired; (4) /enterprise/join?code=XXXX pre-fills invite code and joins the org successfully; (5) /dashboard has 'Enterprise Portal — Team dashboard · Invites · Seats' link card; (6) /intelligence renders 8 signal cards, each 'Affected Courses' chip is a Sparkles-icon button (32 total); clicking opens patch-modal with proposed_title + markdown proposed_content + module_title + rationale + status='proposed' badge; close button + backdrop click both close modal. All previous flows (login, register, catalog, course detail, freshness badges) still functional. Router refactor: server.py=133 lines (down from 906), all 8 routers (auth, catalog, assessment, tutor, intelligence, checkout, dashboard, enterprise) mounted and responding.

minor.issue: Docs say '10-5000 range enforcement' — endpoint correctly enforces MIN=10 AND MAX=5000 AND cannot-reduce-below-current-usage, but the require_admin=True check gates the endpoint before the 'owner-only' check, so an ADMIN (not just owner) gets a distinct 403 with 'Only the owner may adjust seats' — behavior matches spec but the intermediate _resolve_org_for_user require_admin gate is technically dead-code for this endpoint since we re-check role after. Cosmetic.
Uses raw dict body instead of Pydantic model — email/role/department are not validated by Pydantic. Manual '@' check only. Suggest OrgInviteCreate model with EmailStr for stricter validation.
Uses raw dict body for course_slug. Would benefit from a Pydantic model (ApplySignalRequest) matching payload={'course_slug': str} + optional 'notes'.
Accepts course_slug/status as raw query params without a Literal enum on status — a caller could pass status='banana' and get an empty list rather than 400. Low priority.

issues: Readiness Index card shows '0/ 100' with a hairline space before '100' due to <span> unit rendering — visually reads as '0 / 100' but the '/ ' has extra whitespace. Cosmetic.
On narrow desktop (≤1280px) the 12-col grid squashes the stats sub-grid (courses/certs/avg) — 3 stats stacked on 2 lines. Consider md:grid-cols-3 with reserved column widths.

Sparkles-prefixed chip buttons are dense (2 rows of 3-4 chips per card); hover state uses same brand color as normal state — no visual affordance signaling clickability beyond the Sparkles icon. Consider chip hover:bg-brand/5 border-brand/40.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Wrap /api/enterprise/organizations/invites, /api/intelligence/signals/{id}/apply, /api/intelligence/patches/{id}/decide in Pydantic request models for stricter validation instead of raw dict payloads.
LOW: Minor design polish for the Readiness Index '/100' spacing and Sparkles chip hover state.
LOW: Consider adding a status enum validation on GET /api/intelligence/patches?status= to 400 unknown values.
critical_code_review_comments: Router refactor is clean — server.py dropped from ~906 → 133 lines. Shared code (db/logger/helpers) correctly lives in core.py. All 8 routers mount cleanly. Excellent maintainability win.
enterprise_router.create_organization: after inserting the org via motor, mutates local dict then pops _id — motor's insert_one mutates the passed doc by injecting _id. The pop happens correctly. OK.

enterprise_router seat_count guard duplicates work: OrganizationCreate.seat_count has no field-level validation, but create_organization clamps via max(10, min(5000, ...)). Consider moving the clamp into Pydantic (Field(ge=10, le=5000)) to reject invalid inputs at parse time with 422.
intelligence_router._generate_patch imports emergentintegrations types inside the function scope — should be at module scope for micro-perf (called per patch). Minor.

intelligence_router.decide_patch does NOT verify the caller has permission (any authenticated user can approve/reject any patch). Consider gating to admin/curriculum_editor role or restricting to patch.created_by. Currently exposed to all learners.

curriculum_patches doesn't enforce a unique index — a signal can be applied multiple times against the same course, producing duplicate patches. May be intentional (allow re-drafts) but consider deduplicating by (signal_id, course_slug, status='proposed').
seed_industry_courses.py + seed_more_courses.py + seed_data.py duplicate module/quiz-scaffold logic — consider extracting a shared _course_scaffold(slug, title, modules, quiz) helper.
Frontend EnterprisePortal.jsx uses browser confirm()/alert() for member removal error handling — replace with a design-system dialog for consistency.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered per test (test.ent+<ts>, pusher+<ts>, joiner+<ts>, dash+<ts>, owner+<ts>, member+<ts>, invitee+<ts>, noorg+<ts>, another+<ts> / TestPass123!).
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded 24 catalog courses + intelligence cache. Registered ~10 ephemeral users + created 2 test orgs (TEST Acme <ts>, TEST Org <ts>) during testing. Curriculum patches inserted: 1 (approved) from Push-to-Curriculum backend test.
